synthesis.guidance: Start with clear text commands, adding a leading icon only when it improves scanning. Reserve trailing visuals for meaningful secondary cues, not repeated decorative badges. ItemPlayground passes selectionVariant to ActionList and selected/active state to the item; distinguish current navigation from selected choices instead of painting both alike. Match row heights, icon alignment and separators to the product, preserving a visible focus target for each interactive row. Short command lists often need no card shadow. Copy link/Quote reply/Edit comment are upstream reference labels, not implemented actions. These are partial stories with omitted imports and arguments; verify actual routing, keyboard behavior and installed Primer APIs.

synthesis.summary: ActionList stories show simple command rows and explicit LeadingVisual/TrailingVisual slots within each item. Useful for compact contextual actions or selectable product navigation.
